rationale: This is a bounded rule for withholding judgment. The mapping licenses weakening through authenticated, independent, discriminating inconsistencies; inconsistency resting solely on unauthenticated or single-origin material does not meet that standard. Withholding weakening does not establish that the hypothesis is true or the material false.
signal_basis: Hypotheses carrying substantial inconsistency from authenticated, independent, discriminating items are weakened or set aside.
